transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'd like to get the postmortem for Tuesday's webhook incident moving. As a reminder, the initial investigation points to the queue-worker deployment as the immediate trigger, and we've confirmed no permanent loss of webhook payloads. Before I can sign the final postmortem remediation register and assign follow-up work, our policy requires final status from the backend, SRE, security, and support owners. Can each of you give me your current status so we can close this out?
